description: Workers communities public institutions and experts share authority over transition pathways.
Participation becomes routine in foresight policy budgets evaluation and public learning.
Communities generate future pathways and demand institutional uptake and resources.
Digital platforms scale engagement but shape voice through interface data and moderation design.
Experts and powerful institutions define futures with limited public contestability.
Institutions invite input but decision influence remains weak.
Future narratives become weapons in political conflict and public trust erodes.
